purpose: ADDITIVE conformance vectors for action_ref v2 (domain-separated derivation). Does NOT replace or narrow the existing v1 fixture set — a v2-conformant verifier MUST still pass all v1 vectors. Each vector pairs the v1 hash (unchanged derivation) with the v2 hash (same four fields, domain tag prepended before hashing, 'v2:' prefix on the result) for the identical preimage, to demonstrate the two never collide.

vectors.description: NEXUS oracle signal example — same preimage as the worked v1 example already published in docs/spec/action-ref.md ('Serialization — JCS' section). v1 value here is copied from that published example, not recomputed, to prove this fixture is grounded in the live spec.
Memory write example — same preimage as the worked v1 example already published in docs/spec/action-ref.md ('Memory provenance attestation' section).
Synthetic third vector (payment.send), not tied to a prior published example, to avoid the fixture set relying on only two reused cases.

version_marker_conformance.note: A conformant verifier determines the derivation from the action_ref string's own syntax, never from context or assumption.
version_marker_conformance.rule: action_ref_version(s): 'v1' if len(s) == 64 (bare hex); 'v2' if s.startswith('v2:') and len(s) == 67; ValueError otherwise.
